text: Implemented exact hard-gated projected-patch normalization and one shared sign-mixture loss with strict positive outlier floor, stable shifted two-pass centering, log-space posterior weights, finite invalid-patch cost, exact gradient scaling, and PSD EM/GN curvature scaling. The explicit test-only C/P/J oracle remains separate from production. Both JVM and Scala.js pass 12 Flashalign tests total, including 45 polarity-prior/tau/floor finite-difference settings, gain/offset and large-offset invariance, low-contrast and invalid-support costs, nonfinite rejection, correlation bounds, posterior normalization, PSD probes, and deliberate falsification of the softened-norm projector formula.
